name: Gore Barrage already reduces Animated Blood's cost by 30% (#3668)
contract: REGRESSION ONLY - nothing is changed for this issue. Gore Barrage 807345 reads 'Reduces the cost of spells that cost health and Animated Blood by $s1%'. Its effect 0 is aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -31 (-30%) and EffectSpellClassMask (3507750913, 2285969409, 2149647768), whose first word has bit 0 set - Animated Blood 573299 carries SpellFamilyFlags (1, 0, 0) and is therefore covered. That clause is delivered entirely by native code and needs no data: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod registers the modifier and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies it through Player::ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COST). The assertion is a ratio against the same spell's unmodified cost, so it holds whatever the base Rage cost is. Effect 1 of 807345 is a second, tooltip-less aura 42 on Bloodshards 504741 that is inert for the usual ProcFlags-0 reason; no tooltip clause claims it and it is deliberately not exercised here.
